tools.name: mail.messages.search
tools.description: Search recent Yandex Mail messages via IMAP XOAUTH2 using the logged-in user's OAuth token. Each message includes subject/from/to/date/message_id, a short text preview (default 2000 chars, tunable via text_max_chars; disable via include_text=false), and is_bounce flag (delivery-status notifications / mailer-daemon). Set unseen_only=true to return only unread messages. Use mail.messages.get for full body + attachments.

tools.name: mail.messages.send
tools.description: Send a Yandex Mail message via SMTP XOAUTH2 using the logged-in user's OAuth token. Required: to, subject, body. Optional: cc.

tools.name: mail.messages.get
tools.description: Fetch a full Yandex Mail message by mailbox and message id via IMAP XOAUTH2 using the logged-in user's OAuth token. Returns headers, plain-text body, HTML body, attachment metadata (filename, content_type, size), and is_bounce flag. Set include_attachments_content=true to also inline each attachment's bytes as content_base64 (skipped with content_skipped note above 10 MB). Use mail.messages.search to discover message ids first.

tools.name: mail.messages.mark_read
tools.description: Update the \Seen IMAP flag of one Yandex Mail message via IMAP XOAUTH2 using the logged-in user's OAuth token. By default marks the message as read; set unread=true to mark it as unread instead. Use params={mailbox:'INBOX', id:'<id from mail.messages.search>'}. Read-only fetching never flips flags, so transcript/file-processing workflows should call this after a message is fully handled.

tools.name: mail.folders.list
tools.description: List Yandex Mail folders (IMAP LIST) using the logged-in user's OAuth token. Returns each folder's decoded name (custom folder names arrive as IMAP modified UTF-7 and are decoded here), the raw IMAP name, the hierarchy delimiter, and flags. Use the decoded name as the destination for mail.messages.move.

tools.name: mail.messages.move
tools.description: Move one Yandex Mail message to another folder via IMAP COPY + \Deleted + EXPUNGE using the logged-in user's OAuth token. Required: id (from mail.messages.search) and destination (folder name from mail.folders.list, e.g. a custom folder; non-ASCII names are UTF-7 encoded and quoted automatically). Message flags such as unread state are preserved.
